E003-01.notes: Subject 'most of them' is plural (refers to signs) in a past-tense sentence -> 'were'. B and D are singular; B also wrong tense. Small twist: 'most' takes number from 'them'.

E003-02.notes: Series of three items needs commas after each item before 'and'. A omits comma after 'brush'; B semicolons unwarranted for simple items; C misplaces comma after 'and'.

E003-03.notes: Possessive 'their' (the stores' windows); 'onto' is the correct single preposition of motion.

E003-04.notes: Past perfect correctly marks action prior to/continuing up to the past narrative ('learned') with 'since before she was born'. B present and C present perfect clash with past frame; D creates fragment in relative clause. NO CHANGE answer will draw some second-guessing.

E003-05.notes: Parallelism: three infinitive phrases 'to mix... to space... to make'. A and B mix infinitives with a 'that' clause/gerund; D mixes infinitive with gerunds.

E003-06.notes: Two independent clauses joined correctly with a semicolon. B comma splice; C fused sentence; D 'which' creates garbled clause with redundant 'them'.

E003-07.notes: Conjunctive adverb 'however' between two independent clauses requires a semicolon before it and a comma after. A/D comma splices; C no punctuation.

E003-08.notes: Precise, formal wording; 'peeled and faded' specifies the failure. A and D too informal/vague; B vague.

flags: minor: correct choice is noticeably the longest and most detailed, a length cue
E003-09.notes: D echoes the garage and scrap-board alphabet practice from paragraph 2 and sets up 'Her students' in the next sentence (A leaves 'students' without antecedent). B and C don't connect to how she learned.

flags: minor: correct choice is the shortest, the usual ACT redundancy tell
E003-10.notes: 'young' is redundant with 'in their twenties'. C doubles the redundancy; D wordy and still redundant.

E003-11.notes: Essay is a profile of Marrow; vinyl appears only in one paragraph as a challenge. D is factually false; A/B cite details too narrow to be a history.
